product.title: Sagrada Familia & Barcelona Small Group Tour with Hotel Pick-up

description.text: In Barcelona, join this small-group tour of the Catalan capital, and discover Gaudi’s magnificent Sagrada Familia (tickets separate expense). Also on this tour, enjoy a walking tour of Barcelona’s Old Town and Gothic Quarter; admire Modernist architecture including Casa Batlló, Casa Mila, and Casa Lleó; and take in the views from Montjuïc Mountain. Stops include Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló, Montjuïc. Hotel or apartment pick-up and drop-off are included. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
